_readme: Where a Boat Show Price request gets emailed, keyed by the dealer name as
Giselle emails these dealers already (the workbook's MASTER sheet tracks an
EMAIL BLAST column and a sent date per dealer), so the addresses exist; they
are just not in anything the site holds. Ask her for the list.
Use a role address the dealership actually monitors (sales@, info@) over a
single salesperson, so a lead does not die in someone's holiday inbox during
the show. More than one address per dealer is allowed.
A dealer with no entry here CANNOT receive a lead. Leave them out rather than
guessing an address: a bounced or wrong-inbox lead is worse than a form that
honestly falls back to the phone number.
All 12 dealers below have boats on the site today. The remaining 8 show
dealers are waiting on models and need entries before their boats go live.
